summary: Escalade, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 24, 2026, announcing the acquisition of substantially all assets of ASL Solutions, Inc., a manufacturer of insulated dog houses, for an undisclosed sum. The deal was disclosed via press release on August 25, 2026. Escalade, a sporting goods and recreation company, seeks to expand into the pet market and add rotational molding capabilities. No financial terms, advisors, or premium were disclosed, and the asset acquisition was deemed immaterial for financial reporting. The transaction closed upon announcement; watch for integration and potential synergies in pet product lines.
